title: Intl. Collectors' Edition: card flavor text

entities.name: Justina
entities.description: A woman who cast a great spell to imbue her weapons with her life force as evil ones came to slay her.

entities.name: Najib
entities.description: A ruler who retreated to his castle at El-Abar and was dead by morning.

entities.name: El-Abar
entities.description: The site of Najib's castle, whose walls were reduced to rubble in a single night.

entities.name: Dwarven Demolition Team
entities.description: Dwarven forces that destroyed the walls of Najib's castle in one night.

entities.name: Mi'cha
entities.description: A man who threw a drunken soldier over ten meters.

entities.name: Norin the Wary
entities.description: A cautious man who was dared to touch a Jade Statue.

entities.name: Pashalik Mons
entities.description: Leader of the Goblin raiders of Rundvelt.

entities.name: Mons's Goblin Raiders
entities.description: Rundvelt Goblin raiders led by Pashalik Mons.

entities.name: Rundvelt
entities.description: A land of Goblins whose affairs are likened to the chaos of a thundercloud.

entities.name: Gnerdel
entities.description: An Ogre philosopher who believed life's purpose was to live as high on the food chain as possible.

entities.name: Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar
entities.description: Author of The Underworld Cookbook.

entities.name: Institute of Arcane Study
entities.description: An institution whose members sometimes acquire a taste for worldly pleasures.

entities.name: Lord of Atlantis
entities.description: A master of tactics who makes his people bold in battle merely by arriving to lead them.

entities.name: Atlantis
entities.description: A sunken land that scholars believe Merfolk survived from.

entities.name: Dominia
entities.description: The world Demons were created to destroy and Grizzlies roam.

entities.name: Hela
entities.description: A figure who will call the bones of sinners forth for the final battle at Ragnarok.

entities.name: Ragnarok
entities.description: The final battle for which the bones of sinners wait in the Great Wall in Hel.

entities.name: Zombie Master
entities.description: A controller of zombies, said to have commanded them before his own death and now one of them.

entities.name: Goblin King
entities.description: The ruler of the Goblins, who must assassinate the previous king to take the throne.

entities.name: Llanowar Elves
entities.description: Elves who leave one plant of each type untouched when gathering the fruits of their forest.

entities.name: Scryb Sprites
entities.description: Faerie-like sprites who routed intruders.

entities.name: Hurloon Minotaurs
entities.description: Minotaurs of the Hurloon Mountains who love battle and sing hymns for the dead.

entities.name: Hurloon Mountains
entities.description: The mountain home of the Minotaurs.

entities.name: Sursi
entities.description: A village where a woman visits the land of the Mesa Pegasus before marrying.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: A land with a caste system that changes with the lunar year.

entities.name: Ironclaw Orcs
entities.description: A deviously cowardly Orc clan.

events.summary: Justina casts a great spell, imbuing her weapons with her life force, as evil ones approach to slay her.
events.quote: she cast a great spell, imbuing her weapons with her own life force

events.summary: Najib retreats to his castle at El-Abar and is found dead the next morning.
events.quote: Foolishly, Najib retreated to his castle at El-Abar; the next morning he was dead.

events.summary: Dwarven forces reduce the walls of Najib's castle to rubble in one night.
events.quote: In just one night, the dwarven forces had reduced the mighty walls to mere rubble.

events.summary: Mi'cha throws a drunken soldier over ten meters before the blow lands.
events.quote: His blow never landed; Mi'cha flung the brute over ten meters.

events.summary: Norin is dared by others to touch the Jade Statue.
events.quote: Some of the other guys dared me to touch it, but I knew it weren't no ordinary hunk o' rock.

events.summary: The Scryb rout intruders, who flee.
events.quote: Then those intruders who were still standing turned and fled.

events.summary: Gnerdel refuses to eat vegetarians, living on creatures that prey on sentient beings.
The Zombie Master, said to have controlled zombies in life, becomes one of them in death.
events.quote: now that he is one of them, nothing can make them betray him

relations.quote: Pashalik Mons and his raiders are the thunderhead that leads in the storm.

relations.note: The dwarven forces destroyed Najib's walls.
relations.quote: In just one night, the dwarven forces had reduced the mighty walls to mere rubble.
Najib retreated to his castle at El-Abar
The Minotaurs of the Hurloon Mountains are known for their love of battle.

relations.note: Hela will call the bones forth at Ragnarok.
relations.quote: Hela will call them forth for the final battle.
